sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach are in outstanding form with seven wins from their last ten games and currently top the table with 22 points, while visitors Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just four points and have won only once in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a trip to Dawley Town as they chase Sandbach, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a fixture between high-flying sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, currently fourth, travel to Wednesfield Community in a match between mid-table sides. Bilston Town (6th) welcome Foley Meir (13th) in a clash between contrasting form teams, with Bilston riding recent momentum. New Mills host struggling Market Drayton Town in a fixture between sides fighting mid-table battles. Cheadle Heath Nomads, second-bottom, visit Telford Town (third-bottom) in a basement-area clash, while Crewe entertain Allscott Heath and Shawbury United face Barnton in matches involving lower-table sides. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, the division's only pointless side, in what should favour the hosts.
